description: Load one agent tool by name. A "pro" (read-only) tool: its README (what it checks, how to run it) plus its file list. Add `path` to read one listed file, e.g. the source. The tool runs on the user's machine, not here. Before saving, running or scheduling anything from it, show the user what it does and get their explicit OK. Each file comes with its sha256. For a "download" tool you get its README and a download link (valid 15 minutes) with the archive's sha256 instead. Needs a Pro key; without one you get the summary and how to unlock it.

path.description: Optional file within the tool, as listed by read_agent_tool.

name: read_agent_tool
title: Read an agent tool
